rows.value: French Polynesia, an overseas collectivity under article 74 of the French Constitution, has its own tax powers (organic law 2004-192 of 27 February 2004, art. 13) and its own tax code, administered by the DICP; French national taxes do not apply to its residents, and a tax treaty with France avoids double taxation. There is no general tax on the total income of individuals; earnings bear the contribution de solidarité territoriale (CST). Social insurance is run by the CPS. Amounts are in CFP francs (XPF).
